_about: The roadmap section on /anyps/. Up to four columns, each a list of items: title (required) and note (optional). Keep it honest: no dates, no percentages, no promises. The last column mirrors the "Not yet" list at the end of the page's complete feature list; keep the two in step.
note: Plans can change. Nothing here is a promise or a date.

items.title: AnyPS V1.05.1
items.note: A snappy in-game overlay, Memory tools fixed on PS3, My saved values and mods that stay on.

items.title: 32-bit Windows edition
items.note: PSP only: the other emulators exist only as 64-bit programs.

items.title: One-press updates
items.note: V1.05: AnyPS downloads just the new program and restarts. Games, saves and sign-ins stay put.

items.title: A PS5 lane
items.note: The last system, started only once PS1 to PS4 are fully solid.

items.title: A verified-games compatibility table on this site

columns.title: Not yet
columns.lead: Out of reach with today's emulators.

items.title: An audio equaliser, HDR, macros and turbo, colour-blind filters
items.note: They need hooks none of the emulators offer.

items.title: Save states on PS Vita and PS4
items.note: Vita3K and shadPS4 have no save states.
